operations.name: feedback.posts.list
operations.summary: The posts of the board board, those matching search where it is given, up to limit (default 100, at most 1000): {board, posts, count, complete}, each post {id, board, title, details, status, score, url}, never its author; complete says whether every post fit within limit.

operations.name: feedback.posts.create
operations.summary: Create a post on the board board with title and details, authored by the portal's user of the customer email: answered {id, url, board, replayed}. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself.

operations.name: feedback.posts.vote
operations.summary: Count the vote of the portal's user of the customer email on the post post: answered {post, counted, replayed}; the portal holds one vote per customer and post. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself.
